items.title: Advanced nuclear power plant could be coming to Aberdeen Proving Ground in Maryland
Italy's Senate approves a return to nuclear power
items.summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's bill paving the way for a return to nuclear power in Italy after four decades was passed in the Senate by 81 votes to 51, with seven abstentions.
